v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dixit Dóminus * Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis. ‡
text.en: The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand. ‡

text.la: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
text.en: Great are the works of the Lord, * sought out according to all his wills.

text.la: Qui timet Dóminum, * in mandátis eius cupit nimis.
text.en: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord; * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments. ‡

text.la: Sit nomen Dómini * benedíctum in sǽcula.
text.en: Blessed be the name of the Lord * from henceforth now and for ever.

text.la: Deus autem noster * in cælo: ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, fecit.
text.en: But our God is in heaven, * he hath done all things whatsoever he would.

text.la: Fratres: Si linguis hóminum loquar, et Angelórum, caritátem autem non hábeam, factus sum velut æs sonans, aut cýmbalum tínniens.
text.en: Brothers: If I speak with the tongues of men, and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

text.la: Stans autem Iesus, * iussit cæcum addúci ad se, et ait illi: Quid vis ut fáciam tibi? Dómine, ut vídeam. Et Iesus ait illi: Réspice, fides tua te salvum fecit. Et conféstim vidit, et sequebátur illum, magníficans Deum.
text.en: And Jesus stood, * and commanded the blind man to be brought unto Him, and He asked him, saying: What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? Lord, that I may receive my sight. And Jesus said unto him: Receive thy sight, thy faith hath saved thee. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Him, glorifying God.

text.la: Preces nostras, quǽsumus, Dómine, cleménter exáudi: atque, a peccatórum vínculis absolútos, ab omni nos adversitáte custódi.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech You, mercifully hear our prayers; loose us from the chains of our sins and keep us from all adversity.
